lines: We make buying or leasing your Land Rover simple, flexible and efficient. Choose from our range of finance products, and offers - all designed to match your purchasing needs.

Whether you’re looking for a Consumer Loan to help you purchase your new Land Rover outright, or a Novated Lease through your salary package, the choice is yours. Finance options available to approved applicants. Fees and eligibility criteria apply.

With tailored financed solutions available, a consumer loan could be the perfect solution to experience the thrill of a brand new Land Rover. Enjoy 100% finance for approved customers, fix your interest rate, choose the term of your loan and customise your repayment.

From the self-employed to large corporations — there’s a Land Rover Financial Services solution for every business. Our financial business products can help your company meet your business finance needs.
Visit our Finance Calculator to estimate your weekly payment for our range of vehicles.
We look forward to hearing from you, whether you’re looking to invest in your first Land Rover, or you’re an existing Land Rover Financial Services customer and have a question about your finance.
